metadata.article_title: Courts, authorities and officers to continue to function subject to the provisions of the Constitution

article.title: Courts, authorities and officers to continue to function subject to the provisions of the Constitution
article.content:
375Courts, authorities and officers to continue to function subject to the provisions of the Constitution

Article 375 · Part XXI
All courts of civil, criminal and revenue jurisdiction, all authorities and all officers, judicial, executive and ministerial, throughout the territory of India, shall continue to exercise their respective functions subject to the provisions of this Constitution.
